rows.grounds: compound member qualifying īśvarī; ṣaḍ-āmnāya refers to the six transmission streams
predicate adjective; without parts or divisions
predicate adjective; free from grasping or attachments

items.question: By what essential attributes is the sovereign goddess of the six transmission streams characterized?
premises: The goddess is sovereign over the six transmission streams.
She is partless and without possessions.
items.inference: The sovereign goddess of the six transmission streams is defined by eternality, partlessness, and freedom from possession.
items.plain_english: The sovereign goddess of the six transmission streams is eternal, partless, and without possessions.
